purpose: Describe a complete machine-intelligence organization without assuming neural, symbolic, probabilistic, programmatic, or OCM-specific realization.

fields.Theta_configuration: mutable parametric/symbolic configuration not represented structurally in G
fields.morphology_classifier_version: frozen classifier/equivalence procedure used in experiments

phenotype.Q_capability: externally verified capability vector under ecology E
phenotype.S_structure: registered structural observables robust to encoding changes

hybrid: two or more non-equivalent realization families coupled behind explicit interfaces

anti_label_rule: A morphology class is not established from source-code or architecture vocabulary alone. It must survive the bounded equivalence and phenotype tests.
new_form_rule: NEW_MORPHOLOGY_CANDIDATE requires non-equivalence to registered known forms plus a reproducible new capability/resource/developmental region; visual or syntactic novelty is insufficient.
